_about: The NHS counts waits by hospital department (treatment function). Each department has a plain name, a one-line description, a friendlier version of its NHS name and a line icon. 'icon' is the inside of a 24x24 SVG drawn with strokes (no fill); the page wraps it in <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'>. Departments are listed in the order shown on screen. C_999 is only used on the Explore screen. admitted_label/clinic_label are how this department's two kinds of completed wait are described (admitted = with a hospital stay or procedure; clinic = non-admitted). admitted_noun/clinic_noun are the same in the middle of a sentence.
